036/**
037 * A var resolver session that combines a {@link VarResolver} with one or more session objects.
038 *
039 * <p>
040 * Instances of this class are considered light-weight and fast to construct, use, and discard.
041 *
042 * <p>
043 * This class contains the workhorse code for var resolution.
044 *
045 * <p>
046 * Instances of this class are created through the {@link VarResolver#createSession()} and
047 * {@link VarResolver#createSession(WritableBeanStore)} methods.
048 *
049 * <h2 class='section'>Notes:</h2><ul>
050 *    <li class='warn'>This class is not guaranteed to be thread safe.
051 * </ul>
052 *
053 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2><ul>
054 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/MarshallSimpleVariableLanguage">Marshall Simple Variable Language</a>
055 * </ul>
056 */
057@SuppressWarnings({
058   "java:S1192", // Duplicated literals (argument/property names) read more clearly inline than as constants
059   "resource" // VarResolver resources managed by calling code
060})
061public class VarResolverSession {
062
063   private static boolean containsVars(Collection<?> c) {
064      var f = Flag.create();
065      c.forEach(x -> {
066         if (x instanceof CharSequence && x.toString().contains("$"))
067            f.set();
068      });
069      return f.isSet();
070   }
071
072   private static boolean containsVars(Map<?,?> m) {
073      var f = Flag.create();
074      m.forEach((k, v) -> {
075         if (v instanceof CharSequence && v.toString().contains("$"))
076            f.set();
077      });
078      return f.isSet();
079   }
080
081   private static boolean containsVars(Object array) {
082      for (var i = 0; i < Array.getLength(array); i++) {
083         var o = Array.get(array, i);
084         if (o instanceof CharSequence && o.toString().contains("$"))
085            return true;
086      }
087      return false;
088   }
089
090   private static final Set<String> HTML_DOC_PASSTHROUGH_VARS = Set.of("W", "C", "RS");
091
092   private static final Set<String> SCRIPT_STYLE_REFUSED_VARS = Set.of("RQ", "RH", "RF", "RP", "RA", "SA", "R");
093
094   private final VarResolver context;
095
096   private final WritableBeanStore beanStore;
097
098   // Per-thread resolve state, so one session can safely be shared by concurrent callers.
099   private static final class ResolveState {
100      int recursionDepth;
101      int resolveDepth;
102      int budgetSegments;
103      long budgetChars;
104      int exprVarDepth;
105      boolean htmlDocEncode;
106      boolean scriptStyleRefuse;
107   }
108
109   private final ThreadLocal<ResolveState> state = ThreadLocal.withInitial(ResolveState::new);
110
111   // Cap on nested resolve() calls on one thread, including re-entrant ones that do not go through resolveRecursive().
112   static final int MAX_RESOLVE_DEPTH = 128;
113
114   // Per top-level resolve() work caps: bound the total variable substitutions and the text they produce.
115   static final int MAX_SEGMENTS = 10_000;
116   static final long MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS = 1L << 20;
117
118   private Function<Object,String> valueFormatter;
119   private Function<String,Object> scope;

121   /**

124    * @param context

126    *    that resolver.

128    *
129    */
130   public VarResolverSession(VarResolver context, WritableBeanStore beanStore) {

132      this.beanStore = new BasicBeanStore(beanStore);

135   /**
136    * Looks up a registered function by exact name.
137    *
138    * <p>
139    * Functions excluded by {@link VarResolver.Builder#allowFunctions(String...)} are not returned, so a
140    * <jk>null</jk> result means absent <i>or denied</i>; use {@link #isFunctionDenied(String)} to tell them apart.
141    *
142    * @param name The function name.
143    * @return The function, or <jk>null</jk> if none is registered under that name (or it is not allowed).
144    */
145   public VarFunction findFunction(String name) { return context.findFunction(name); }
146
147   /**
148    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if the named function (or operator) is excluded by the resolver's allowlist.
149    *
150    * @param name The function name (e.g. <js>"upper"</js> or <js>"$op.add"</js>).
151    * @return <jk>true</jk> if the name was registered and filtered out by the allowlist, or is an <c>$op.*</c> name the allowlist does not permit.
152    */
153   public boolean isFunctionDenied(String name) { return context.isDenied(name) || (name.startsWith("$op.") && ! context.isAllowed(name)); }
154
155   /**
156    * Resolves a <c>${Type:body}</c> reference to a typed value for the expression evaluator.
157    *
158    * <p>
159    * Finds the var by prefix and returns <c>var.doResolveValue(session, body)</c>, so defaults ({@link DefaultingVar})
160    * and multipart keys are honoured.  The body is resolved with the existing nested-marker machinery first when the
161    * var allows nesting and the body contains a <c>$</c>.  The {@link #resolveScriptStyle(String)} refusal and the
162    * {@link #resolveHtmlDoc(String)} encoding apply exactly as they do to template <c>${...}</c> references: under
163    * HTML-doc encoding a value from a non-passthrough var is escaped, and a non-<c>String</c> value other than a
164    * <c>Number</c> or <c>Boolean</c> is first converted with <c>String.valueOf</c> (as the template path does), so
165    * markup inside a collection or bean cannot bypass the escaping.
166    *
167    * @param prefix The var name (e.g. <js>"S"</js>).
168    * @param body The var body (already in the var's own syntax, e.g. <js>"key,default"</js>).
169    * @return The value, or <jk>null</jk> if absent or (lenient mode) the var is unknown.
170    * @throws VarResolverException If the var is unknown and the resolver is strict, or the var fails.
171    */
172   Object resolveValue(String prefix, String body) {
173      var v = isScriptStyleRefused(prefix) ? null : getVar(prefix);
174      if (v == null) {
175         if (context.strict)
176            throw new VarResolverException("Unknown or unavailable variable '%s'", prefix);
177         return null;
178      }
179      try {
180         var b = (v.allowNested() && body.indexOf('$') != -1) ? resolve(body) : body;
181         var r = v.doResolveValue(this, b);
182         // HTML-doc chrome: values are escaped unless the var is an HTML passthrough, as in templates.
183         if (! state.get().htmlDocEncode || r == null || r instanceof Number || r instanceof Boolean)
184            return r;
185         return applyHtmlDocChromeEncoding(prefix, r instanceof String s2 ? s2 : String.valueOf(r));
186      } catch (VarResolverException e) {
187         throw e;
188      } catch (Exception e) {
189         throw new VarResolverException(e, "Problem occurred resolving variable '%s': %s", prefix, e.getMessage());
190      }
191   }

193   /**
194    * Overrides the value formatter for this session.
195    *
196    * <p>
197    * The override <em>replaces</em> the resolver's formatter and also formats {@link Structure} values.
198    *
199    * @param value The formatter.  <jk>null</jk> reverts to the resolver's formatter.
200    * @return This object.

202   public VarResolverSession valueFormatter(Function<Object,String> value) {

204      return this;

207   /**
208    * Sets the render scope for this session.
209    *
210    * <p>
211    * Bare identifiers inside <c>#{...}</c> expressions (outside any <c>.?[...]</c> / <c>.![...]</c> element) are looked
212    * up through this function.  A <jk>null</jk> result means the name is absent.  Inside a projection the element is the
213    * innermost scope and this function is the fallback for names the element lacks.
214    *
215    * <p>
216    * Expressions that contain identifiers are never folded at compile time, so a scope can differ per session.
217    * core <c>${...}</c> references do not read this scope; a resolver can register a var (such as the template layer's <c>P</c> var) that does.
218    *
219    * @param value The scope lookup.  <jk>null</jk> clears the scope (every identifier is absent).
220    * @return This object.
221    */
222   public VarResolverSession scope(Function<String,Object> value) {
223      this.scope = value;
224      return this;
225   }
226
227   /**
228    * Returns the render scope.
229    *
230    * @return The render scope, or an always-absent scope if none was set.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
231    */
232   public Function<String,Object> scope() { return scope == null ? ExprSegment.EMPTY_SCOPE : scope; }
233
234   /**
235    * Formats the typed result of an expression as text.
236    *
237    * @param value The value.  May be <jk>null</jk>.
238    * @return The text; never <jk>null</jk>.
239    */
240   public String formatValue(Object value) {
241      String r;
242      if (valueFormatter != null)
243         r = valueFormatter.apply(value);
244      else if (value instanceof Structure)
245         r = value.toString();
246      else
247         r = context.valueFormatter.apply(value);
248      return r == null ? "" : r;
249   }

251   /** @return The maximum collection size for expressions, and for the functions that build lists, tables and joins. */
252   public int maxCollectionSize() { return context.maxCollectionSize; }
253
254   /** @return The maximum expression nesting depth. */
255   int maxExprDepth() { return context.maxExprDepth; }
256
257   /**
258    * Enters a {@code ${...}} reference inside {@code #{...}}.
259    *
260    * <p>
261    * Such references compile their body lazily, so a deep {@code #{${...#{${...}}...}}} chain would recurse at
262    * evaluation time.  The chain is capped at {@code maxExprDepth}; every successful call must be paired with
263    * {@link #exitExprVar()}.
264    *
265    * @return <jk>false</jk> (and no depth change) if the cap is reached.
266    */
267   boolean enterExprVar() {
268      var st = state.get();
269      if (st.exprVarDepth >= context.maxExprDepth)
270         return false;
271      st.exprVarDepth++;
272      return true;
273   }
274
275   /** Leaves a reference entered with {@link #enterExprVar()}. */
276   void exitExprVar() {
277      state.get().exprVarDepth--;
278   }

300   /**
301    * Returns the bean from the registered bean store.
302    *
303    * @param <T> The value type.
304    * @param c The bean type.
305    * @return
306    *    The bean.
307    *    <br>Never <jk>null</jk>.
308    */
309   public <T> Optional<T> getBean(Class<T> c) {
310      Optional<T> t = beanStore.getBean(c);
311      if (! t.isPresent())
312         t = context.beanStore.getBean(c);

316   /**
317    * Resolve all variables in the specified string.
318    *
319    * @param s
320    *    The string to resolve variables in.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <jk>null</jk>).
321    * @return
322    *    The new string with all variables resolved, or the same string if no variables were found.
323    *    <br>Returns <jk>null</jk> if the input was <jk>null</jk>.
324    */
325   public String resolve(String s) {
326      if (s == null)
327         return null;
328      if (s.isEmpty())
329         return s;
330      var st = state.get();
331      enterResolve(st);
332      try {
333         return context.compile(s).resolve(this);
334      } finally {
335         st.resolveDepth--;
336      }
337   }
338
339   /*
340    * Brackets a top-level or re-entrant resolve: resets the work budget on the outermost call and bounds nesting.
341    */
342   private void enterResolve(ResolveState st) {
343      if (st.resolveDepth >= MAX_RESOLVE_DEPTH)
344         throw new VarResolverException("Maximum variable resolution nesting depth (%s) exceeded.", MAX_RESOLVE_DEPTH);
345      if (st.resolveDepth++ == 0) {
346         st.budgetSegments = 0;
347         st.budgetChars = 0;
348      }
349   }
350
351   /**
352    * Charges one variable substitution of the given size against this resolve's work budget.
353    *
354    * @param chars The number of characters produced by the substitution.
355    * @throws VarResolverException If the budget is exhausted.
356    */
357   void charge(int chars) {
358      var st = state.get();
359      st.budgetChars += chars;
360      if (++st.budgetSegments > MAX_SEGMENTS || st.budgetChars > MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS)
361         throw new VarResolverException("Variable resolution work limit exceeded (%s substitutions, %s characters).", MAX_SEGMENTS, MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS);
362   }
363
364   /**
365    * Re-resolves a var's output, enforcing the resolver's maximum recursion depth.
366    *
367    * @param s The string to resolve.
368    * @return The resolved string.
369    * @throws VarResolverException If the maximum recursion depth is exceeded.
370    */
371   String resolveRecursive(String s) {
372      var st = state.get();
373      if (++st.recursionDepth > context.maxRecursionDepth) {
374         st.recursionDepth--;
375         throw new VarResolverException("Maximum variable recursion depth (%s) exceeded while resolving '%s'", context.maxRecursionDepth, s.length() > 80 ? s.substring(0, 80) + "..." : s);
376      }
377      try {
378         return resolve(s);
379      } finally {
380         st.recursionDepth--;
381      }
382   }
383
384   /**
385    * Resolves SVL variables for HTML-doc chrome fields that write raw HTML.
386    *
387    * <p>
388    * Literal characters from the template (including tags) pass through unchanged. Each SVL
389    * substitution is XML-escaped via {@link StringUtils#escapeXml(String)} before insert, except
390    * the HTML-passthrough vars {@code $W}, {@code $C}, and {@code $RS}.
391    *
392    * <p>
393    * Plain {@link #resolve(String)} is unchanged. Use this only for HTML-doc chrome (aside, header,
394    * footer, nav HTML fragments, head, no-results).
395    *
396    * @param s The chrome template. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
397    * @return The resolved chrome string, or <jk>null</jk> if the input was <jk>null</jk>.
398    */
399   public String resolveHtmlDoc(String s) {
400      var st = state.get();
401      var old = st.htmlDocEncode;
402      st.htmlDocEncode = true;
403      try {
404         return resolve(s);
405      } finally {
406         st.htmlDocEncode = old;
407      }
408   }
409
410   /**
411    * Resolves SVL variables for {@code <script>} and {@code <style>} chrome.
412    *
413    * <p>
414    * Request-derived vars ({@code $RQ}, {@code $RH}, {@code $RF}, {@code $RP}, {@code $RA},
415    * {@code $SA}, {@code $R}) are left unresolved (same as an unknown var). Other vars including
416    * {@code $W}, {@code $C}, and {@code $RS} still resolve.
417    *
418    * @param s The script or style template. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
419    * @return The resolved string, or <jk>null</jk> if the input was <jk>null</jk>.
420    */
421   public String resolveScriptStyle(String s) {
422      var st = state.get();
423      var old = st.scriptStyleRefuse;
424      st.scriptStyleRefuse = true;
425      try {
426         return resolve(s);
427      } finally {
428         st.scriptStyleRefuse = old;
429      }
430   }

432   /**
433    * Compiles the given template string into a reusable {@link VarTemplate}.
434    *
435    * <p>
436    * Equivalent to {@link VarResolver#compile(String) this.context.compile(input)}; provided on
437    * the session for symmetry with {@link #resolve(String)}. The returned template is bound to
438    * the underlying {@link VarResolver}, not to this session — see the {@link VarTemplate}
439    * class javadoc for the compile-binding contract.
440    *
441    * @param input The template string. May be {@code null}.
442    * @return A new {@link VarTemplate} bound to the underlying resolver.
443    */
444   public VarTemplate compile(String input) {
445      return context.compile(input);
446   }
447
448   /**
449    * Returns a session-bound {@link Supplier} that re-resolves the given template against
450    * <i>this</i> session each time {@link Supplier#get()} is called.
451    *
452    * <p>
453    * Unlike {@link VarResolver#resolveSupplier(String)} — which opens a fresh session per
454    * {@code .get()} and is threadsafe to share — this Supplier captures the existing session
455    * and reuses it. <b>It is therefore not threadsafe</b>; it inherits the standard
456    * "{@link VarResolverSession} is not guaranteed to be thread safe" contract.
457    *
458    * <p>
459    * Use this variant only when the caller owns the session lifecycle and the perf saving of
460    * skipping per-call session construction matters. For shared / cross-thread use cases,
461    * prefer {@link VarResolver#resolveSupplier(String)}.
462    *
463    * @param input The template string. May be {@code null}.
464    * @return A {@code Supplier<String>} bound to this session.
465    */
466   public Supplier<String> resolveSupplier(String input) {
467      return compile(input).asSupplier(this);
468   }
469
470   /**
471    * Resolves the specified strings in the string array.
472    *
473    * @param in The string array containing variables to resolve.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or a {@link NullPointerException} is thrown, though individual elements can be <jk>null</jk>.
474    * @return An array with resolved strings.  Elements are <jk>null</jk> where the corresponding input element was <jk>null</jk>.
475    */
476   public String[] resolve(String[] in) {
477      var out = new String[in.length];
478      for (var i = 0; i < in.length; i++)
479         out[i] = resolve(in[i]);
480      return out;
481   }

483   /**
484    * Convenience method for resolving variables in arbitrary objects.
485    *
486    * <p>
487    * Supports resolving variables in the following object types:
488    * <ul>
489    *    <li>{@link CharSequence}
490    *    <li>Arrays containing values of type {@link CharSequence}.
491    *    <li>Collections containing values of type {@link CharSequence}.
492    *       <br>Collection class must have a no-arg constructor.
493    *    <li>Maps containing values of type {@link CharSequence}.
494    *       <br>Map class must have a no-arg constructor.
495    * </ul>
496    *
497    * @param <T> The value type.
498    * @param o The object.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <jk>null</jk>).
499    * @return The same object if no resolution was needed, otherwise a new object or data structure if resolution was
500    * needed.  Returns <jk>null</jk> if the input was <jk>null</jk>.
501    */
502   @SuppressWarnings({
503      "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for recursive resolution logic
504      "rawtypes", // Raw types necessary for generic resolution
505      "unchecked" // Type erasure requires unchecked operations
506   })
507   public <T> T resolve(T o) {
508      if (o == null)
509         return null;
510      if (o instanceof CharSequence o2)
511         return (T)resolve(o2.toString());
512      if (isArray(o)) {
513         if (! containsVars(o))
514            return o;
515         var o2 = Array.newInstance(o.getClass().getComponentType(), Array.getLength(o));
516         for (var i = 0; i < Array.getLength(o); i++)
517            Array.set(o2, i, resolve(Array.get(o, i)));
518         return (T)o2;
519      }
520      if (o instanceof Set o2) {
521         try {
522            if (! containsVars(o2))
523               return o;
524            Set o3 = info(o).getDeclaredConstructor(x -> x.isPublic() && x.getParameterCount() == 0).map(ci -> safe(() -> (Set)ci.inner().newInstance())).orElseGet(LinkedHashSet::new);
525            Set o4 = o3;
526            o2.forEach(x -> o4.add(resolve(x)));
527            return (T)o3;
528         } catch (VarResolverException e) {
529            throw e;
530         } catch (Exception e) {
531            throw new VarResolverException(e, "Problem occurred resolving set.");
532         }
533      }
534      if (o instanceof List o2) {
535         try {
536            if (! containsVars(o2))
537               return o;
538            List o3 = info(o).getDeclaredConstructor(x -> x.isPublic() && x.getParameterCount() == 0).map(ci -> safe(() -> (List)ci.inner().newInstance())).orElseGet(() -> list());
539            List o4 = o3;
540            o2.forEach(x -> o4.add(resolve(x)));
541            return (T)o3;
542         } catch (VarResolverException e) {
543            throw e;
544         } catch (Exception e) {
545            throw new VarResolverException(e, "Problem occurred resolving collection.");
546         }
547      }
548      if (o instanceof Map o2) {
549         try {
550            if (! containsVars(o2))
551               return o;
552            Map o3 = info(o).getDeclaredConstructor(x -> x.isPublic() && x.getParameterCount() == 0).map(ci -> safe(() -> (Map)ci.inner().newInstance())).orElseGet(LinkedHashMap::new);
553            Map o4 = o3;
554            o2.forEach((k, v) -> o4.put(k, resolve(v)));
555            return (T)o3;
556         } catch (VarResolverException e) {
557            throw e;
558         } catch (Exception e) {
559            throw new VarResolverException(e, "Problem occurred resolving map.");
560         }
561      }
562      return o;
563   }
564
565   /**
566    * Resolves variables in the specified string and sends the output to the specified writer.
567    *
568    * <p>
569    * More efficient than first parsing to a string and then serializing to the writer since this method doesn't need
570    * to construct a large string.
571    *
572    * @param s The string to resolve variables in.  Can be <jk>null</jk>, in which case the writer is left unchanged.
573    * @param out The writer to write to.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
574    * @return The same writer.
575    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
576    */
577   public Writer resolveTo(String s, Writer out) throws IOException {
578      if (s == null)
579         return out;
580      if (s.isEmpty()) {
581         return out;
582      }
583      var st = state.get();
584      enterResolve(st);
585      try {
586         return context.compile(s).resolveTo(this, out);
587      } finally {
588         st.resolveDepth--;
589      }
590   }

617   /**
618    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if this session is resolving HTML-doc chrome and substitutions should be XML-escaped.
619    *
620    * @return <jk>true</jk> if HTML-doc chrome encoding is enabled.
621    */
622   boolean isHtmlDocEncode() {
623      return state.get().htmlDocEncode;
624   }
625
626   /**
627    * Returns <jk>true</jk> if {@code varName} must be left unresolved in script/style chrome.
628    *
629    * @param varName The SVL var prefix (e.g. <js>"RQ"</js>).
630    * @return <jk>true</jk> if the var should fall through like an unknown var.
631    */
632   boolean isScriptStyleRefused(String varName) {
633      return state.get().scriptStyleRefuse && SCRIPT_STYLE_REFUSED_VARS.contains(varName);
634   }
635
636   /**
637    * XML-escapes an SVL substitution when HTML-doc chrome encoding is enabled and the var is not passthrough.
638    *
639    * @param varName The SVL var prefix.
640    * @param replacement The resolved substitution text.
641    * @return The possibly escaped replacement.
642    */
643   String applyHtmlDocChromeEncoding(String varName, String replacement) {
644      if (! state.get().htmlDocEncode || replacement == null || HTML_DOC_PASSTHROUGH_VARS.contains(varName))
645         return replacement;
646      return escapeXml(replacement);
647   }
648}
